Jason and Paul celebrate the 32nd birthday of Pearl Jam's fourth record Vitalogy...by removing tracks from it! It's series called LP2EP where you have to distill the record down the tracks that fit onto an EP -- which is 30min or less. It's a tough task to maintain the album's core themes and musicality in almost half the time. What would you pick?
